description:
Grand Prince Seongnyeong, 'Yi Jong', was a learned man who loved reading, but had a weak constitution.  
For the purpose of eliminating political enemies, he and his friend, a fellow student under the same teacher, were abandoned on a dreadful island… but they must live!  
They made desperate efforts to survive along with the survivors on this deserted island with nothing.  
And as he gradually grew up, he rapidly went from strength to strength with a monarch's disposition and intelligence he inherited from his father, Bang-won.  
All around him, the abandoned group brandished their blades of revenge.  
Would they be able to succeed in getting revenge?!

**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/55012183), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1434009695), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=4950538), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/mongamdo), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/mongamdo_s)

Note: This is a fantasy story that references real historical figures, but does not correspond to historical facts. It tells a story about Grand Prince Seongnyeong (Yi Jong), the son of King Taejong (Yi Bang-won), who was deposed and abandoned on a secluded island by his own father to prevent bloody power struggle within the royal family that could arise because the problematic Crown Prince Yangnyeong (Yi Je) lacked the qualities for kingship.
